summary: All 29 model sessions in this bundle open with exactly one user text message before their first assistant line, carry no summary record and were not resumed or forked (probes/freshness.json, written by this launch). The check is mechanical over the transcripts; no session was asked whether it was fresh.
establishes: P02 on this runtime, and two things the #149 rule did not cover. A session that dispatches a background worker receives that worker's completion as a further user message, so the rule has to count what opened the session apart from what the harness injected. And the runtime attaches context of its own to every session: an environment block naming the working directory, the model identity, the agent roster, a token counter, the remaining dollar allowance, the operator's email address, the date and a commit-attribution reminder. A cell's context is not only its prompt.
residual: Three of those attachments are freeze business. budget_usd injects the remaining allowance, which is why P08a could decline a task as unaffordable. agent_listing_delta names the frozen worker without its model, so the arms' rosters match, but it also offers the harness's built-in agent types. session_context carried only the operator's email here because --restricted ignores user and project settings - a property of the launch shape, not the runtime. An earlier run of this probe, over the ten sessions that existed when it ran, is retained under run-1/.
read_from: the probe's own retained output, not asserted beside it
